title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Conduct Hold Schedule for Re-Sent Payouts
content:
Schedule of conduct holds applied when a returned payout is re-sent on a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account.

A conduct hold is kept back from the re-send according to the active violation points the shopper carries on the contractor account held in Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, as that account shows them on the day of the re-send:

| Active violation points | Conduct hold kept back |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 25.00 |
| 1 to 5 | 10.00 |
| None (0) | Nothing |

The hold is taken off the amount drawn for the re-send and stays on the unpaid earnings balance; the re-send never falls below zero.

**Edges of the bands.** 5 active points fall in the 1 to 5 band and keep back 10.00; 6 active points reach the 6-or-more band and keep back 25.00. 1 active point keeps back 10.00; 0 active points keep back nothing. Only active points count — points that have been cleared or have expired are not carried on the account and play no part.

*Hypothetical case:* a re-send with 90.00 drawn, for a shopper carrying 7 active violation points, has 25.00 kept back by the conduct hold, leaving 65.00 before anything else is taken off.
